title: Constant weight code A(34,6,6)
statement: Find binary words of length 34, each with exactly 6 ones and any two differing in at least 6 positions, as many as possible: a lower bound on A(34,6,6). The best known lower bound in Andries Brouwer's table of constant weight codes is 2,056 (our code of 2,046 words plus 10 words added by Andries Brouwer); the best known upper bound is 2,992. A code with more words improves it.
submission: Text file: one word per line, the 6 positions of its ones, distinct integers from 1..34 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Andries Brouwer's table of constant weight codes (aeb.win.tue.nl/codes/Andw.html), A(34,6,6) >= 2,056: our code of 2,046 words plus 10 words added by Andries Brouwer, listed since 2026-11-03 (before it 2,018); read 6 Nov 2026 13:28 UTC (page last modified 5 Nov 2026 22:34 GMT)
